result.title: Copying Under Repetition: From Prefix Matching to Position Hashing
result.summary: Frontier LLMs can copy random text almost flawlessly, yet they often overrun or truncate long blocks of repeated characters. In repeated strings, matching local content no longer reliably identifies where copying should continue or when it should stop. Nevertheless, we show that a two-layer transformer with $O(\log\log N)$-bit precision and $O(\log N/\log\log N)$ width can copy every string up to a chosen design horizon $N$ and terminate correctly under arbitrary repetition. We use RoPE-style rotations of attention values and outputs (VO-rotations) with small prime periods to encode distances from delimiter anchors modulo those primes. By the Chinese Remainder Theorem, these periodic encodings jointly distinguish all required distances, allowing one retrieval rule to select either the next source token or the end marker. In contrast, we prove a width-independent impossibility result for copying under sequential finite-precision softmax accumulation. It applies to transformers whose only positional input is an additive attention bias that eventually becomes constant, including NoPE and a recursive implementation of ALiBi. Once an identical-token run exceeds the resulting saturation threshold, further repetitions leave the logits unchanged. If this threshold grows sublinearly with $N$, these models cannot both complete a long all-identical copy and stop correctly, a pattern resembling the termination errors of frontier LLMs. In synthetic copying experiments, baseline transformer models fail on long repeated strings even within the training range. Trained VO models, by contrast, generalize beyond the training lengths with near-perfect accuracy up to length $\approx 5005$, the selected primes' period product.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究重复字符串复制中的位置消歧与正确终止问题：提出用带小素数周期的 RoPE 式注意力值/输出旋转（VO-rotations）编码相对分隔符锚点的距离，借中国剩余定理由一条检索规则决定取下一源 token 还是结束标记；同时证明在顺序有限精度 softmax 累加下（含 NoPE 与递归 ALiBi 类加性位置偏置）存在与宽度无关的不可行性，即重复片段超过饱和阈值后 logits 不再变化。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文对位置哈希、重复导致的 logits 饱和与终止判定的分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态里位置与内容的区分、信息坍缩，以及 STOP 决策和长度泛化提供可核查线索；但其为纯文本合成任务，与视觉多模态推理的联系尚待核查。
